sources.rule: a register use kept as rN because a fn-entry (E), CALL result (C), CALL / CLOS pseudo-def (X) value reaches it gets that value bound to a named local right after its source: a bind LW(K, R(h)) (text NAME = rN) in the first body step after the source on every path (a J / BR body step that is not a TP step; never registers 48, 147, 194 or pc / key). With the bind, every reaching definition is a statement write, so localizeProven makes the reads V(K). A bind is kept only when it becomes an LW, is not redundant and its local has at least 2 reads (one read just moves the rN to the bind line); binds are re-placed until fixpoint
sources.leftReasons: E / X / C: bind dropped (fewReads 882: its local would have one read, so the bind only moves the rN to the bind line; notLocal 91: the bind def stays in an rN web because a read of that web is also reached by a value no kept bind covers), or no bind step exists (the walk from the source meets a CTRL step, a non-body BR or a multi-successor J before a J / BR body step), or the read is the BR condition of the bind step itself (binds sit after that read). NOLOC 48 / 147 / 194: VM-internal registers (try-stack, handler value, frame) kept by rule. Table operands (guards, RET values, CALL args): rendered from the table, not from the text
sources.rawFresh: chk-sound-h138 counts register reads left in the text whose home provably holds a local: 14 (probe_4_fetch / probe_5_fetch catch blocks: webs() sends the defs reaching anywhere in a step to its handler, freshness the state at the throwing statement, so a bind earlier in the same step is not credited)
